title: Download only pdf file
close_reason: Filter applied at ingestion: convertToModel and ToAttachments now drop non-PDF attachments before they reach the attachments table or the download worker. isPDF uses filepath.Ext + strings.EqualFold. Added 14 test cases across 4 test functions in internal/idx/announcement_test.go; gofmt, go vet, go build, and go test ./internal/idx/... all pass. Pre-existing test bugs in attachment_worker_test.go fixed in the same change. Backfill cleanup tracked in bloodhound-9h3; pre-existing blobstorage test build failure tracked in bloodhound-vfr.

title: Cleanup non-PDF attachment rows
description: Existing rows in the attachments table from before the PDF filter landed still include .zip, .xlsx, etc. Add a one-off SQL migration (or DELETE) that removes rows whose IdxURL / OriginalFilename / PDFFilename does not end in .pdf, then verify with SELECT count(*). Discovered while implementing bloodhound-x4y.
close_reason: Added scripts/cleanup-non-pdf-attachments.sql (manual psql, not a migration per user direction). One-off DELETE of attachments rows where none of idx_url, original_filename, filename end in .pdf (case-insensitive via ILIKE). Schema note in header: the PDF column is filename, not PDFFilename as the original issue described. Verified against a temp Postgres 18.3 cluster: seeded 5 rows (3 PDFs incl. one case-mix B.PDF, one edge-case original .zip with rewritten .pdf filename, plus c.zip and d.xlsx). Script previewed 2 would-delete rows, DELETE 2, after=3, leftover_non_pdf=0. Backup-before-run warning included in script header.
